title: Draft DAO governance optimizer architecture spec
description: Write docs/architecture/p09-dao-governance.md: vote-weight simulator, strategy engine, quorum/timelock guards, proposal tracker, and the simulation-only invariant — the swarm NEVER broadcasts an on-chain vote. Acceptance: spec maps gates (quorum, timelock) to enforcing components and proves the no-broadcast boundary in the data-flow diagram.

title: Define interfaces for governance simulation
description: Create src-level interfaces (Python protocols + Solidity stubs if needed): IVoteSimulator, IStrategyEngine, IProposalTracker with typed signatures for simulation, scoring and guard checks. Acceptance: contracts/protocols compile or type-check; the no-broadcast rule is declared as an interface-level invariant.

title: Model governance value-extraction economics
description: Write docs/economics/p09-governance-economics.md: SINAX-proven voting strategy value model, bribe/emission capture math, 5 bps fee to Treasury, risk budgets (min capital $10, max_alloc_pct 0.25). Acceptance: model reproduces target 3% APR scenarios; fee flow traces to Treasury.

title: Scaffold p09 repo layout and interfaces
description: Create src/sincor2/defi/p09_gov/, tests/pytest/test_p09_*, configs/agents/p09-governance-agent.yaml; wire the interfaces from the spec with one-line READMEs per directory. Acceptance: tree exists, imports resolve, type checks pass cleanly.

title: Starter simulator and governance agent boilerplate
description: Write the vote simulator and Python governance agent skeletons with TOA hooks, structured logging, and the no-broadcast assertion stub. Acceptance: agent boots, simulation runs on fixtures, stub test green.

title: Build vote-weight simulation engine
description: Implement the vote-weight simulator: delegation graphs, quorum projection, outcome probabilities under configurable strategies, with a Python engine in src/sincor2/defi/p09_gov/simulator.py. Acceptance: simulator reproduces recorded historical votes within documented tolerance; every run is reproducible from a seed.

title: Build SINAX-proven voting strategy engine
description: Implement the strategy engine ranking voting strategies for maximum value extraction, with SINAX proof stubs attesting strategy validity. Acceptance: engine ranks fixtures deterministically; strategies that violate quorum/timelock guards are rejected, never ranked.

title: Build quorum and timelock guard enforcer
description: Implement the guard enforcer: any strategy or recommendation must satisfy quorum and timelock constraints before being emitted. Acceptance: guard-violating strategies are rejected with logged reasons; tests cover quorum-fail and timelock-fail matrices.

title: Enforce no on-chain vote broadcast in code
description: Implement the no-broadcast boundary: the swarm has no signing path to any governance contract, and a runtime assertion kills any attempt to construct a vote transaction. Acceptance: tests attempt every conceivable broadcast path and all are blocked; static analysis shows no governance-call calldata builders.

title: Build proposal tracker
description: Implement the proposal tracker ingesting DAO proposals, deadlines, quorum states and outcomes with idempotent records. Acceptance: tracker reconciles against fixture chains; missed or duplicate proposals are detected and reported.

title: Build governance agent loop
description: Build the Python agent loop: track proposals, simulate strategies, emit recommendations with guard attestations. Acceptance: full track-simulate-recommend cycle on fixtures with TOA telemetry and error handling.

title: Handle governance optimizer edge cases
description: Handle proposal cancellation, quorum rule changes mid-vote, bribe market data gaps, and timelock delays shifting. Acceptance: each case has a dedicated test and docs/ops/p09-edge-cases.md incident write-ups.

title: Unit tests for simulator and guards
description: Write tests/pytest/test_p09_unit.py covering simulation math, guard matrices and the no-broadcast assertion. Acceptance: 100% pass; broadcast attempts asserted blocked.

title: Integration tests for agent recommendation flow
description: Write tests/pytest/test_p09_integration.py: agent tracks, simulates, recommends with guard attestations on fixture DAOs. Acceptance: full flow green; no-broadcast boundary exercised end-to-end.

title: Fuzz and invariant tests for simulation safety
description: Fuzz delegation graphs and proposal parameters; assert invariants: guards never bypassed, no broadcast path exists, recommendations are deterministic per seed. Acceptance: 10k+ fuzz runs green; counterexamples fixed and recorded.

title: Mainnet-fork simulation of governance strategies
description: Replay historical DAO votes on a mainnet fork through the simulator. Acceptance: report in tests/reports/p09-fork-sim.md comparing simulated vs actual outcomes with reproducible block pins.

title: Audit-prep package for governance optimizer
description: Assemble docs/audits/p09/: frozen code, threat model (broadcast bypass, guard gaming, data poisoning), guard map. Acceptance: complete component inventory and the no-broadcast boundary documented.

title: Remediate governance optimizer audit findings
description: Fix all findings, prioritizing broadcast-boundary and guard issues; each fix links to its finding ID. Acceptance: zero open high/medium; regression tests for each fix pass.

title: Gas optimization for governance components
description: Optimize the onchain guard and tracker paths without weakening the no-broadcast boundary. Acceptance: before/after gas report in docs/audits/p09/gas.md; zero behavioral change in tests.

title: Technical docs for governance optimizer
description: Write docs/p09-dao-governance.md: simulator reference, strategy model, guard semantics, no-broadcast invariant. Acceptance: a new builder can run the simulator from the docs alone; references resolve.

title: Agent YAML config and ops runbook
description: Write configs/agents/p09-governance-agent.yaml and docs/ops/p09-runbook.md (deploy, monitor, proposal incidents). Acceptance: agent boots from YAML; runbook covers quorum-fail and cancellation incidents.

title: Dashboard and monitoring hooks
description: Expose tracked proposals, strategy rankings, guard states and recommendation log in the status feed. Acceptance: feed reports real values or 'unknown', never fabricated 'healthy'.

title: Testnet deploy scripts for governance optimizer
description: Write scripts/deploy/p09/ deploying trackers to Base Sepolia with the no-broadcast boundary asserted at deploy time. Acceptance: idempotent scripts; deployment recorded; broadcast attempt on testnet provably blocked.

title: Mainnet readiness checklist for governance optimizer
description: Write docs/ops/p09-mainnet-checklist.md: audit sign-off, data-source trust, key custody, no-broadcast re-verification. Acceptance: checklist signed off by the auditor task; boundary re-tested before any mainnet step.
